poses: slight side pose to show garment silhouette
walking pose with natural fabric movement
hands relaxed, not covering garment details
one hand gently adjusting collar or sleeve
seated lifestyle pose with garment still visible
default_pose: confident full-body pose, hands relaxed, garment details clearly visible
default_lighting: soft commercial studio lighting with clean shadow contrast
composition: model occupies most of the frame
sharp fabric texture and realistic fit
default_composition: full-body model image, garment centered and clearly visible, clean background with no distractions
reference_image_note: If a product reference image is provided, preserve the garment color, silhouette, fabric texture, pattern, length, neckline, sleeve shape, hemline, and key construction details. Do not invent logos, prints, or trims.
prompt_prefix: Create a high-converting ecommerce fashion model image.
prompt_suffix: The garment must remain the main subject, with realistic fit, clear silhouette, accurate fabric texture, natural model pose, clean commercial composition, professional lighting, no watermark, and no unauthorized logo.
